title: test: imagereader layout probe for the e0b clips

commit.merge_subject: merge: test: imagereader layout probe for the e0b clips

description: E0b-2's first task: a diagnostic device test that decodes the first frames of a clip as ByteBuffer, YUV_420_888 ImageReader and P010 ImageReader and logs Image format, planes, strides, HardwareBuffer format and decode ms/frame (clips are read from files/probe in the app data). Findings are in docs/ENCODED_GPU_DECODE_PLAN.md section 7: HW decode runs both owner clips at about twice real time (4K 10-bit 60p 8.0-9.0 ms/frame, 8K 16.6 ms/frame); P010 reader images arrive as format 54 with three planes, vendor-private HardwareBuffer format, Y height padded to 2176; a YUV_420_888 reader gets no images from a 10-bit stream and aborted the process on 8K (cause not shown in the log).
